task: Classify molecular subtype in gastric adenocarcinoma. Classes: CIN, GS, MSI, and EBV. On H&E, distinguish gland-forming chromosomal instability tumors, poorly cohesive genomically stable tumors, lymphocyte-rich or mucinous MSI tumors, and EBV-associated carcinomas with striking lymphoid stroma.

classes.0: CIN subtype with conventional gland-forming intestinal-type morphology, marked cytologic atypia, and desmoplastic invasive growth.
classes.1: GS subtype with poorly cohesive or diffuse infiltration, discohesive cells, and limited gland formation.
classes.2: MSI subtype with prominent tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, mucinous or poorly differentiated areas, and pushing borders.
classes.3: EBV subtype with dense lymphoid stroma and syncytial or poorly differentiated carcinoma cells in a lymphocyte-rich background.
